newsitem.title: USA: APL Ltd sees profitable year.
newsitem.headline: APL Ltd sees profitable year.

text.p: Container carrier APL Ltd said its first quarter, normally slow, was weakened by rate pressures in all markets, but it continued to expect a profitable year.

"As 1997 progresses, we fully expect that stronger volumes, a stablilizing rate situation and continued cost reductions at APL will result in a profitable year," APL president and chief executive Tim Rhein said.
The company reported a first quarter earnings loss of $0.40 per share compared to a profit of $0.05 per share.
APL said its recently-announced proposed merger with Neptune Orient Lines would lead to broad service scope and economies of scale.
"Even for the short term, we are very encouraged that our ongoing focus on cost reductions and improving internal effeciencies are partially offsetting the impact of rate pressures," Rhein said.
APL provides container transportation and logistics services.
